text:
maya: Quick runbook thread — we need final landing copy and launch sequence for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Deliverables: hero variants (2 each), one-line pitch, 3 benchmark bullets with micro-metrics for the sidebar, exact form fields + hidden keys for routing, social snippets (short/thread/email), and webinar gating plan. Can we freeze by tomorrow noon?
oscar: I'll own the hero variants and micro-CTAs. Two tonalities: "product clarity" and "customer outcome". Posting drafts below.
li: I'll handle microcopy for forms and the consult checkbox, plus the small privacy blurb. Keep UX minimal.
nate: Routing ops: propose hidden key = lead_tier (values: hosted|dedicated|private), hidden utm_launch=2026_q2, consult_flag boolean. Mapping: hosted -> queue_name: hosted_trial_queue; dedicated/private -> queue_name: enterprise_engage_queue. If consult_flag == true -> add tag: needs_followup. I'll also add rule: if est_monthly_tokens > 100000000 -> escalate to enterprise_sdr.
marta: Benchmark narrative plan: three short micro-cases (latency-sensitive microservices, large-batch embeddings, regulated enterprise). For each, I'll provide a 200-250 word mini-case plus a method callout: model family, avg seq len, GPU type. Example metric we'll use: "4.2x throughput improvement with workload-aware batching".
social-bot: social-schedule: staging posts queued once pages are live. Awaiting manual release.
oscar: HERO DRAFTS -- PRODUCT CLARITY TONE:
HOSTED H1: "Hosted API for immediate LLM features."
HOSTED H2: "Predictable latency, transparent pricing, SDKs and streaming."
CTA: "Explore Hosted"

DEDICATED H1: "Reserved GPU pools for sustained production."
DEDICATED H2: "Throughput you can depend on with SLAs and autoscale."
CTA: "Secure Capacity"

PRIVATE H1: "Private inference in your VPC or on-prem."
PRIVATE H2: "Compliance-grade controls, KMS, and audit trails."
CTA: "Request Private Demo"

oscar: HERO DRAFTS -- CUSTOMER OUTCOME TONE:
HOSTED H1: "Ship features faster, skip operations."
HOSTED H2: "From prototype to production with a stable API."
CTA: "Start Hosted Trial"

DEDICATED H1: "Keep latency low under steady load."
DEDICATED H2: "Dedicated capacity that scales predictably."
CTA: "Request Capacity Review"

PRIVATE H1: "Bring inference behind your controls."
PRIVATE H2: "Full data governance and private control plane."
CTA: "Talk to Sales"

li: Microcopy and form fields:
Visible fields: name, email, company (optional), role (dropdown), workload_type (dropdown), est_monthly_tokens (optional), message (optional)
Checkbox label: "Yes, Id like a capacity consult (a rep may contact me)"
Privacy blurb: "We use your info to contact you about this request. See our privacy policy."
Hidden fields: lead_tier (hosted|dedicated|private), utm_launch=redwood_launch_q2, consult_flag (true/false).
Field placeholders: company: "e.g., Acme Inc.", est_monthly_tokens: "approx. tokens/month"
Micro-CTA under bullets: "See benchmark" linking to /benchmarks#launch-grid

nate: Routing webhook example for eng (for devs):
POST /api/leads
payload: { name, email, company, role, workload_type, est_monthly_tokens, lead_tier, consult_flag, utm_launch }
rules: if lead_tier == "hosted" -> assign_queue = "hosted_trial_queue"; else assign_queue = "enterprise_engage_queue"; if consult_flag == true -> tag = "needs_followup"; if est_monthly_tokens > 100000000 -> escalate_to = "enterprise_sdr"
Note: include sf_sync=true in headers to update SFDC.

marta: Benchmark sidebar bullets (short, for landing):
- Latency-first: 18ms median tail (seq 256, A100) — ideal for microservices
- Batch embeddings: 4.2x throughput with intelligent batching (512 seq)
- Regulated: On-prem VPC + audit logs, KMS/HSM validated
I'll prepare a single visual card that highlights these numbers, plus a method anchor: "How we measured" linking to the blog.

oscar: Language notes: keep CTAs consistent in tone but use distinct verbs: Hosted = "Start Hosted Trial" | Dedicated = "Secure Capacity" | Private = "Request Private Demo". Micro-CTAs: "See benchmark" or "Download brief".
li: UX notes: add a small confirmation page after form submit that shows a micro-benchmark snippet (e.g., "Median tail 18ms on sample prompt") to increase credibility. Also include a follow-up email template with the benchmark PDF attached if consult_flag==true.
maya: Webinar gating plan: 30 min + 15 Q&A. Gate the full benchmark PDF and the technical appendix behind registration. Registration fields mirror landing form and pass lead_tier. Webinar CTAs: email reminders, one-click add-to-calendar, and a follow-up automation that triggers a capacity consult email if consult_flag==true. Speakers: CTO (runtime), Head of ML Infra (benchmarks), Solutions Eng (customer patterns).
social-bot: Posting plan proposal:
- Day 0 (Launch): short X post + LinkedIn post linking homepage
- Day 2: benchmark thread on X + LinkedIn long-form with method anchor
- Day 4: webinar invite (open spots) + reminder series
Tags and tracking: utm_campaign=redwood_launch_q2, utm_content=bench_thread, content_platform=linkedin/x

oscar: A/B test plan: Run homepage hero A/B for 14 days: Variant A = product-clarity hero, Variant B = customer-outcome hero. Primary metric = Hosted form CTR; Secondary metrics = consult checkbox rate and webinar signups. If Variant B yields +10% consult_flag rate, roll to 50% traffic.
li: tiny copy asks for dev: exact checkbox text (copy above), hidden key names (lead_tier, consult_flag). Please ensure consult_flag comes through as boolean string "true"/"false".
nate: SFDC mapping: hosted_trial_queue, enterprise_engage_queue, enterprise_sdr. Rules and sample flow chart posted to internal wiki: https://wiki.redwood.ai/launch/routing (mock link). Also adding a Slack alert to #sales when a lead with consult_flag==true and est_monthly_tokens>50M is created.
marta: I'll upload the benchmark mini-cases and the methodology appendix by 09:00 tomorrow, with a short design brief for the sidebar card. Expect files in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-q2 (comments open).
maya: Timeline recap: - Today EOD: oscar push hero comps to figma, li push microcopy to drive, nate wire webhook + SFDC skeleton - Tomorrow 09:00: marta upload benchmarks & method - Tomorrow noon: freeze copy, staging deploy ready - Post-freeze: social scheduling and webinar registration open
social-bot: pages-staging-deploy scheduled: 2026-06-09T18:00Z; social scheduler queued for 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC; both on hold until manual approval.
